title: Three Seasons and One Short Net
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：shell　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shell 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the fisherman ① collected the shell that no boatman in the harbour would have described, and he said the collecting was the whole of the season. The ② shell, meaning the case itself and not the net, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; a shell, he said, is the only thing in a harbour that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ shell in that harbour had the same short net beside it, and the ④ shell at the far pier, meaning the catch they kept for the children to land and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A shell, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the fisherman said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shell was the whole of the matter, meaning the protection and not the case. The ⑥ shell, meaning the protection and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; shell, he said, is either something you collect or the only word that means both a case and a protection. He said the protection is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ shell had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the short net. The ⑧ shell of the whole thing, the fisherman wrote in July, was one harbour and three seasons of describing; shell, he said, is either the catch at the far pier or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shell I remember is the case described in the logbook, which closed in 1987 and is still described as the quietest in the harbour. A ⑩ shell, my mother said in 1989, is the only case that improves by being described; every shell, she said, is a protection that has agreed to look like a case. She said the protection was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 壳；贝壳（指渔港里每一枚旁边的那一枚）
B. n. 壳；贝壳（指那枚壳本身，与小小的渔网相对）
C. 固定搭配：collect the shell 捡这一枚壳
D. n. 壳；贝壳（指留给孩子们起的那一网）
E. n. 壳之事（抽象总称，指一处渔港的壳之事）
F. n. 壳；贝壳（指航海日志里写到、被描述的那一枚）
G. n. 壳、护持（指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 护持（抽象总称，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: collected the shell that no boatman in the harbour would have described
The shell, meaning the case itself and not the net
the shell at the far pier
the shell was the whole of the matter
the shell had become a line in a logbook
The shell of the whole thing
A shell, my mother said in 1989

answers.why: collect the shell 意为“捡这一枚壳”，1980 年那位渔人把渔港里没有一位船工肯描述的一枚壳做了一遍。
shell 意为“壳；贝壳”，指那枚壳本身而不是小小的渔网，它经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被描述。
shell 意为“壳；贝壳”，指渔港里每一枚旁边的那一枚，每一枚旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。
shell 意为“壳；贝壳”，指最远那座码头的留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shell 意为“壳、护持”，指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这枚护持就是那件事的全部。
shell 意为“护持”，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那枚壳，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shell 意为“壳；贝壳”，指航海日志里写到、被描述的那一枚，到 1985 年这一枚成了航海日志里的一行。
shell 意为“壳之事”，渔人七月写道，整件事的壳之事是一处渔港和三个汛期的描述。
shell 意为“壳；贝壳”，我记得的是航海日志里描述过的那一枚，1987 年归港了，至今仍被说成渔港里最安静的一枚。
shell 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，壳是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的壳。
